name: prioritize_merge
title: Move a merge to the front of the queue
description: Make this card's queued merge go next in its repository (one merge runs at a time, in request order), e.g. a fix the queued cards' tests depend on. The running merge is not interrupted; a merge already first is left as it is (moved: false).

reason.description: Why this card goes first: who or what it unblocks. It is shown on the timeline.

annotations.title: Move a merge to the front of the queue
